title: Constructing an inverse-image module action from two unit presentations
statement: Let F:C to D be continuous between small sites, with finite-limit-preserving set inverse image L. Let phi:A to F_*B be a morphism of sheaves of rings and M an A-module sheaf [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Suppose the underlying set sheaf of B has a unit presentation as L of the underlying set sheaf of A, with unit the underlying phi, and the underlying set sheaf of the actual abelian inverse image of M has such a presentation with unit the actual abelian unit [def-weil-pbc-sheaf-pullback-unit-presentation]. Then there exists an inverse-image action [def-weil-pbc-module-inverse-image-action] on that actual abelian inverse image.

source.place: Tags 03D2 and 03D3, lemma-pullback-module and lemma-adjoint-push-pull-modules; the scalar action construction and verification of the module identities.

proof.text: Use the product presentation and transport map to send the source scalar multiplication A times M to M to a sheaf map from B times the actual abelian inverse image to that abelian inverse image. Its naturality gives semilinearity of restrictions, and map_unit gives eta(a m)=phi(a) eta(m).

Compare the two sheaf maps expressing each of the identities one_smul and zero_smul on the abelian presentation, and smul_zero on the ring presentation. Testing on the respective unit sections reduces them to the source laws, preservation of zero and one by phi, and preservation of zero by the abelian unit.

Compare the two sheaf maps for smul_add using the ring times (module times module) presentation, and for add_smul and mul_smul using the ring times (ring times module) presentation. The presentation testing criterion reduces each equality to the corresponding source module law, the ring-hom laws of phi and additivity of the abelian unit. The sheaf maps are natural because restrictions preserve addition, multiplication and the transported action.

Install these six identities as the Module structure on each existing additive section group and return it with the previously proved restriction and unit equations. The carrier and addition were never replaced.

theorem inverseImageAction_of_presentations
    (pr : SheafPullbackUnitPresentation (F := F)
      ((sheafCompose J (CategoryTheory.forget RingCat.{u})).obj A)
      ((sheafCompose K (CategoryTheory.forget RingCat.{u})).obj B))
    (hr : pr.unit = (sheafCompose J (CategoryTheory.forget RingCat.{u})).map φ)
    (pa : SheafPullbackUnitPresentation (F := F)
      ((sheafCompose J (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u})).obj ((toSheaf A).obj M))
      ((sheafCompose K (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u})).obj
        ((sheafPullback F AddCommGrpCat.{u} J K).obj ((toSheaf A).obj M))))
    (ha : pa.unit = (sheafCompose J (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u})).map
      ((sheafAdjunctionContinuous F AddCommGrpCat.{u} J K).unit.app ((toSheaf A).obj M))) :
    Nonempty (InverseImageAction φ M)
